title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: A count and a noun in two words
summary: The check that keeps counts agreeing only looked at the word glued to the count, so two sentences written with a noun in two words kept their plural at one.

highlights.title: Downloading one library source
highlights.description: The progress notification that fetches library sources read downloading 1 library sources when a single dependency was missing.

highlights.title: One library file from one JAR
highlights.description: The index tooltip read incl. 1 library files from 1 JARs.

highlights.title: The check itself had two holes
highlights.description: It read only the word next to the count, and it granted its exceptions by file, which left two files of more than two thousand lines exempt in full. Both holes now fail a test.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: The library sources download notification agrees at one.
The index tooltip agrees at one library file and one JAR.
The count check reads up to two words between the number and its noun.
Its exceptions are granted line by line, and one that no longer matches anything fails the suite.
